contentText:
CES is poised to be the story of RGB LED, with almost every major TV manufacturer set to show off their latest models using the technology. But TCL is hoping to change that narrative, or even overtake it, with its own story - that of the X11L SQD-Mini LED TV.

The X11L uses blue LEDs for its backlight, much like current mini-LED TVs, but it includes two important color improvements - reformulated quantum dots that provide more color than previously, and the UltraColor Filter from TCL CSOT (the company's panel division) to take advantage of those new QDs and deliver more accurate color per pixel.
